description: This file defines the class ZoneNode, which extends PcbNode and encapsulates a layer node within a PCB management system. It includes constructor and accessor methods.

classes.name: ZoneNode
classes.description: A class representing a zone node in a PCB structure, extending PcbNode and containing a reference to a LayerNode.

methods.name: ZoneNode
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a ZoneNode with a name, index, and list of children, and finds its associated LayerNode.

methods.name: getLayerNode
methods.description: Returns the LayerNode associated with this ZoneNode.
